name: Token Dash
design_intent:
TRIALS COLLECT_ALL proof course (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.5, example t_token_dash). Grab every floating token across a void gauntlet on the fastest flight line; the clear-test is every group 'trials_pickup' member latched `collected`. Tokens sit mid-air between pads so the optimal line requires FLYING through them (Rule A) -- a passive bounce cannot thread them. A fall respawns at start_gate (+2s).

MEDAL (time): a clean routed run grabs 6 tokens in ~8-14s. gold 9.0 / silver 15.0 / bronze 26.0.
